question: Should fresh standard StepFun and Step Plan onboarding both move from Step 3.5 Flash to Step 3.7 Flash despite the explicit keep-default decision in the merged catalog PR?
rationale: Provider support establishes that Step 3.7 is selectable, but it does not determine OpenClaw's preferred onboarding default or whether both provider products should change together.

options.title: Keep current defaults
options.body: Close this PR and retain Step 3.5 Flash until a maintainer sponsors a different onboarding policy.

options.title: Sponsor both changes
options.body: Reopen or retain the patch and explicitly approve Step 3.7 Flash as the new default for both standard StepFun and Step Plan.

options.title: Choose defaults separately
options.body: Split the shared default ID so maintainers can move only the provider surface whose rollout is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep current defaults
recommendation.body: Close this PR and retain Step 3.5 Flash until a maintainer sponsors a different onboarding policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged Step 3.7 work records this person's explicit decision to preserve existing defaults and handle any change separately.
